evidence: The development and use of AI presents risks and challenges that may adversely impact the Company's business.
The legal and regulatory environment relating to AI is uncertain and rapidly evolving, both in the U.S. and internationally
AI models, particularly generative AI models, may produce output or take action that is incorrect, that reflects biases included in the data on which they are trained

the complexity of many AI models makes it difficult to understand why they are generating particular outputs. This limited transparency increases the challenges associated with assessing the proper operation of AI models
the Company may rely on AI models developed by third parties, and, to that extent, would be dependent in part on the manner in which those third parties develop and train their models
ai_positioning.summary: TCBI adopte une posture défensive face à l'IA, énumérant les risques réglementaires, opérationnels et de conformité liés au développement et à l'utilisation de l'IA, sans mentionner d'initiatives propres de déploiement ou de leadership technologique.

governance.voting_structure: One vote per share of common stock
